message.Title: Public Preview: Azure Policy support for Azure HorizonDB

Body.Content:
Azure Policy support for Azure HorizonDB is now available in preview, helping you apply governance and observability standards consistently across your HorizonDB deployments.

With the new built-in policy, you can automatically deploy diagnostic settings for Azure HorizonDB clusters to a Log Analytics workspace when the required configuration is missing. This helps you establish consistent monitoring across your HorizonDB environments while reducing the need for manual configuration.

Azure Policy provides a centralized way to define and enforce organizational standards across Azure resources, making it easier to govern HorizonDB deployments at scale.

Learn more.
